MajorGroup.name: CSV format
MajorGroup.Header:
The CSV (comma-separated values) files below are meant for bulk processing in statistical softwares (like R and Stata) and databases.

Please note that most files are compressed using the gzip compression algorithm for faster download, save storage space and increase cross platform compatibility. The `.gz` extension indicates that the file is compressed, and can be read by any application able to work with .zip files. But an added benefit is the possibility to directly read `.csv.gz` files without preliminary file decompression from many software environments (e.g. fread function from "data.table" library in R, read_csv function from "panda" library in Python).
Specific information about the indicators is provided in the table below.

These CSV files are encoded in UTF-8 and all of them have the following columns:

  • SortOrder (numeric): record counter
  • LocID (numeric): numeric code for the location; for countries and areas, it follows the ISO 3166-1 numeric standard
  • Notes (string): symbol linked to location notes file (available for download below)
  • ISO3_code (string): ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 location codes
  • ISO2_code (string): ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 location codes
  • SDMX_code (string): SDMX Global Registry, cross domain code list for geographical areas (version 2.0) represents a combination of reference area codes in M49 and ISO-3166 classification for international data exchange and interoperability https://sdmx.org/?page_id=3215 and https://registry.sdmx.org/ws/public/sdmxapi/rest/codelist/SDMX/CL_AREA/2.0
  • LocTypeID (numeric): code for location type
  • LocTypeName (string): type of location
  • ParentID (numeric): numeric code of the parent location
  • Location (string): name of the region, subregion, country or area
  • VarID (numeric): numeric code for the scenario
  • Variant (string): projection scenario name (Medium is the most used); for more information see Definition of Projection Scenarios
  • Time (numeric): year the data refers to
  • MidPeriod (numeric): numeric value identifying the mid period of the data, with the decimal representing the month (e.g. 1950.5 for July of 1950)

For files with data separated by age, the following columns are available:

  • AgeGrp (string): label identifying the single age (e.g. 15) or age group (e.g. 15-19)
  • AgeGrpStart (numeric): initial age of the age group
  • AgeGrpSpan (numeric): length of the age group, in years

Refer to each file listed below for a description of its specific data columns.

Use the LocID, VarID and MidPeriod columns to link the data across the different files, if necessary.

MajorGroup.name: Interim Update
MajorGroup.Header:
Release date: 19 January 2026

1. Postponement of the next World Population Prospects release

The World Population Prospects 2024 was released on 11 July 2024. The next revision, originally planned for 2026, has been postponed for public release until 11 July 2027.


2. Interim update for Togo population estimates and medium projections

Since the release of the World Population Prospects 2024, more detailed results from the 2022 census of Togo have become available. These results revealed a 12 per cent difference between the official population counts (8.2 million) and the estimated population published in the World Population Prospects 2024 (9.1 million) for the year 2022.


Reason for the update: The discrepancy arose because, in the absence of available documentation of any adjustments applied to published data from the 2010 and 2022 census, population figures for these censuses were adjusted by the Population Division to account for net undercounts based on post-enumeration surveys. However, it has recently been clarified that national statistical authorities had already adjusted the public figures based on this same information, resulting in a double adjustment by the Population Division.


Guidance for users:

  • Updated Figures: We encourage all users requiring the most up-to-date figures for Togo to use this interim update. It provides revised population and vital event counts for estimates from 1950 to 2023, and medium projections from 2024 to 2100.
  • Unchanged Figures: Fertility rates and mortality rates remain unchanged.
  • Other Scenarios: Please note that other projection scenarios for Togo have not been revised in this interim update. Users should interpret those results with caution, taking into consideration the adjustments made here to the medium projection.
  • Global Context: Results for all other locations are unchanged, and global/regional aggregates have not been revised in this interim update.

3. Updated Files

The following files have been updated to correct the population counts for Togo. Results for all other locations are unchanged, and aggregates are not updated in this interim update.
